title: The Endless Well
author: Rafael Vane
blurb: Felix Brightwater, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
